statement: At the pinned kernel revision, dualsense_parse_report handles home, microphone and touchpad from buttons[2] but does not forward bits 0x10/0x20/0x40/0x80 as independent input keys. The SDL PS5 Edge decoder does emit distinct controls for those bits. This source-path difference does not establish the bound driver, firmware behavior or physical Linux event visibility of an attached Edge.

applicability.scope: source parser only; actual binding not observed
